description: Turning ENVOI_MCP_WAKE_V1 off ends the subscriptions created through these tools; subscriptions created through the REST routes are untouched.

steps.does: every subscription stored with createdVia "mcp" reads ended / feature_disabled from the first read or attempt after the flag-off start (§1)
REST-created http-wake subscriptions keep their state; the http-wake epoch does not move
tools/call envoi_wake_status is an unknown tool; the backend falls back to its safety poll with envoi_claim_work
